e: The UN peacekeeping mission in Western Sahara (MINURSO) begins its liquidation phase after 35 years, following the UN Security Council's failure to renew its mandate.
The Spanish Congress of Deputies approves legislation granting Spanish citizenship to Sahrawis born under the Spanish administration of Western Sahara.
The Panama-flagged cargo vessel Dura Bulk, carrying clinker to the port of Laayoune, sinks off the coast after reporting water ingress.
Sweden formally supports Morocco’s proposed autonomy plan for Western Sahara.
